judge_independence: different model weights/architecture/version; same broad family, not independent expert truth

arms.B0: frozen v4 semantic prompt + same common envelope + existing validation
arms.B1: B0 + generic JSON Schema prompt + post-generation validation; no token grammar
arms.B3: B2 draft + generic rereading, both calls charged

ontology: unchanged13types15relations; binding annotations are not published graph edges
matched_budget_meaning: same strict total-token/output/call ceilings, not equal realized usage; one-pass arms may spend their output ceiling at once, B3 splits it and pays repeated source input; report actual costs and do not claim iso-realized-cost causal gains
source_context: same entire native page for all arms; no target answers, no extra pages for B3

decision_rules.generic_solved: one generic arm reaches >=0.8 complete_literal and >=0.9 atomic on applicable independent focuses in BOTH repeats; source-unsupported triple count no higher than B0; per-dimension failures disclosed
decision_rules.remaining_gap: same source-grounded binding failure across repeats in >=2 independent documents after ruling out input/schema/parse/validation losses; indicates mechanism to investigate, NOT automatic novel-algorithm GO
decision_rules.default: insufficient sample, U/disagreement or capacity limitations => necessity unproven; no new mechanism

runtime_decoder: ordinary model sampling in ALL arms; lm-format-enforcer not used during generation; stage.runtime.json records actual settings, overriding the old executor request.constrained intention flag

setup_exclusion.reason: token grammar stalled in tokenizer trie; traceback in generation log; no semantic-method conclusion and no setup outputs reused

independent_sample_unchanged: fixed before generated results; no semantic prompt/threshold tuning using this sample
response_decoder: existing bailian_client._decode_json_content; offline exact-response replay, not new generation or semantic correction
